# pve_storage_rbd (Data Source)

Reads a Ceph RBD storage definition from `GET /storage/{storage}` (type `rbd`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_storage_rbd" "rbd1" {
  storage = "rbd1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage` (String) The storage identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `authsupported` (String) The supported authentication modes for the cluster.
- `content` (Set of String) Allowed content types (PVE `pve-storage-content-list`), for example `images` or `rootdir`.
- `data_pool` (String) The data pool used for erasure coding (PVE `data-pool`).
- `digest` (String) The read-only storage configuration revision (PVE `digest`).
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the storage is disabled.
- `keyring` (String, Sensitive) Client keyring contents for external clusters.
- `krbd` (Boolean) Whether RBD is accessed through the `krbd` kernel module.
- `monhost` (String) Comma-separated list of monitor addresses of the Ceph cluster.
- `namespace` (String) The RBD namespace.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names the storage applies to.
- `pool` (String) The Ceph pool name.
- `type` (String) The storage type, always `rbd` for this data source.
- `username` (String) The RBD Id (Ceph user name) used to authenticate.
